name: threadify-workflows
description: Set up Threadify, then learn from mature posts and prepare the next six drafts through one private growth loop.

interface.longDescription: Start with Get Set Up. Connect your account and agent, confirm your existing knowledge, build your Brain and prepare seven days of posts in your voice. Then use Growth Loop to learn from mature evidence and save a four-proven/two-challenger daily queue without automatic scheduling or publishing. Verify every external result and how to pause.
